name: peste des petits ruminants infectious disease
description: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in ruminants, has_material_basis_in Peste-des-petits-ruminants virus, which is transmitted_by contact with oronasal and ocular secretions, urine, and feces. The infection results_in_formation_of lesions on the gums, lips and palate.
